verdict.rationale: mise documents direct compatibility with asdf: it reads `.tool-versions` as-is and can still use asdf plugins. It also reads idiomatic version files like `.node-version` and `.ruby-version`, so an existing project migrates without rewriting its config. Community users confirm using it as a drop-in asdf replacement and switching from pyenv. Missing for 10: an explicit documented conversion/import command (e.g. turning `.tool-versions` into `mise.toml`), and a dedicated step-by-step migration guide in the evidence.
